description: This file contains utility functions and wrappers for handling streaming data, particularly for XAI tools, including model ID resolution, payload normalization, HTML entity decoding, and stream wrapping for decoding tool call arguments and handling fast mode.

methods.name: resolveXaiFastModelId
methods.description: Resolves a model ID to its fast mode equivalent if available.

methods.name: stripUnsupportedStrictFlag
methods.description: Removes the 'strict' flag from a tool's function object if present.

methods.name: supportsExplicitImageInput
methods.description: Checks if the model input explicitly supports image input.

methods.name: isReplayableInputImagePart
methods.description: Type guard to determine if a part is a replayable input image part.

methods.name: normalizeXaiResponsesFunctionCallOutput
methods.description: Normalizes function call output, extracting text and image parts.

methods.name: normalizeXaiResponsesToolResultPayload
methods.description: Normalizes the payload input for openai-responses API, attaching images if present.

methods.name: decodeHtmlEntities
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities in a string.

methods.name: decodeHtmlEntitiesInObject
methods.description: Recursively decodes HTML entities in an object or array.

methods.name: decodeXaiToolCallArgumentsInMessage
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities in tool call arguments within a message object.

methods.name: wrapStreamDecodeXaiToolCallArguments
methods.description: Wraps a stream to decode tool call arguments in messages.

methods.name: createXaiToolCallArgumentDecodingWrapper
methods.description: Creates a wrapper for streams to decode tool call arguments.

methods.name: wrapXaiProviderStream
methods.description: Wraps a provider stream with multiple wrappers for payload normalization, fast mode, and argument decoding.
